required_classification.minimal_design: One cohesive Buffer-owned three-variant error, exported from its owning module through existing wildcard reexports, carried directly by existing anyhow::Result. Allocation-zero may be a fieldless fixed classification or carry the actual requested BufferByteLength; overflow carries at:BufferByteOffset and bytes:BufferByteLength; logical overrun carries at, bytes and capacity:BufferByteLength. No redundant primitive field, message authority or neighboring optional state.
required_classification.source_semantics: CheckedNone, zero and logical comparison have no underlying std/native Error; Error::source should be None. Do not fabricate TryFromIntError or wrap ordinary native failures in a replacement taxonomy.
required_classification.derivability: Current byte leaves allow Copy/Clone/Debug/PartialEq/Eq if useful. std::fmt::Display/std::error::Error implementation needs no new dependency, lock change, unsafe trait or global result owner.

contracts.contract: new allocates only positive extent; from_upload reaches new before queue write, still rejects empty upload unless consumer explicitly supplies native word. write delegates START to write_at. Addition overflow precedes logical overrun. End equality proceeds to existing native policy.

Exact NoUninit bytes remain borrowed; immediate Validation observer covers actual queue write/allocation under current native policy. Existing ? converts actual wgpu::Error into anyhow directly. Browser/disabled scope policy and device/paired-queue preconditions remain unchanged.

ByteLength and public logical size permit0; prefix admits0 within both logical/physical, reuses same Arc and performs no native work. Native binding separately rejects empty and forged physical extent. A positive-allocation error must not redefine all logical extents as nonzero.

Logical zero returns empty only after extent/host-layout admission; ZST/partial host element errors stay distinct. Actual padding is not returned. MAP_READ direct branch and staging branch preserve native, mapping, poll and callback causes; cleanup remains owned and no new alias guarantee/device-query invented.

GpuResource directly propagates lower anyhow. Static uniform create/write preserves operation primary and secondary observation through resolve_observation; body error stays original when scope succeeds and both causes stay accessible when both fail.

Actual lower wrappers use ? or owning Backend/Gpu/MetalDeviceError cause wrappers rather than early string conversion. Empty sentinel/physical allocation policy remains consumer-owned; Mesh allocates positive then exposes zero logical prefix. No peer count/device producer API migration is required merely to carry this lower error.

Keep actual SDK allocation/write wgpu::Error as its actual current anyhow cause and preserve nested wrappers/downcastable classification; no new native source string or fake source.
Preserve exact-end and zero-byte writes reaching current native policy. Do not skip queue validation solely because upload is empty.
Keep positive native allocation distinct from zero logical prefix/empty read/no-work policy. No ByteLength positivity change or public Buffer field restriction in this bounded repair.
No changes to mapping progress/cancel, staged session association, peer count/stride/device/physical owners, fixture values/cases/oracles/helper bodies/assertions/doctests.
